574-6277-7084.description:

When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Activate Vish Kal by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Vish Kal ability.
Repeat.
574-6277-7084.notes: Once Vish Kal has infinite +1/+1 counters, you may activate its last ability any number of times to reduce the toughnesses of any number of creatures to 0.

When the creature enters as an Ally due to Arcane Adaptation, Haru triggers, earthbending the creature, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Viscera Seer ability, causing you to scry 1.

Repeat each turn.

Resolve the Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Dryad Arbor.

Play Power Depot, which will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Cast Toph either from your hand or from the command zone by paying {2}{R}{G} plus commander tax if applicable.
When Toph enters, it triggers, earthbending Power Depot and putting a number of +1/+1 counters on Power Depot equal to the mana spent to cast Toph, increased by Benevolent Hydra.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Power Depot.
When Power Depot dies, its modular ability and Toph trigger.
Resolve the modular trigger, putting the +1/+1 counters that were on Power Depot onto Crystalline Crawler, increased by Benevolent Hydra.
Resolve the Toph trigger, returning Power Depot from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped. Power Depot will enter with a +1/+1 counter on it due to its modular ability
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability.
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Toph. Choose to return Toph from your graveyard to the command zone.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding {R/G}.
Repeat step 10 until you have enough mana to cast Toph.
Repeat from step 2.

Repeat from step 2.

Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, causing you to copy Narset's Reversal targeting the original Capture of Jingzhou spell, and then return the original Narset's Reversal to your hand.
Resolve the copy of Narset's Reversal, copying Capture of Jingzhou and returning the original Capture of Jingzhou to your hand.
Resolve both copies of Capture of Jingzhou from steps 3 and 7, causing you to take two extra turns after this one.
Repeat during your second extra turn.
